text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These tools learn from huge amounts of data, such as paintings, songs, and books, and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, follows patterns and rules. It does not truly feel or understand what it makes. So, while AI can be a helpful tool for artists and writers, human creativity remains special and difficult to replace.
